label: Tanned smooth-talker, navy gilet, bookcase
prompt: A still from a laptop's built-in webcam during a work video call, the picture soft, blocky and smeared by heavy compression, with the colours slightly washed out and the shadows turning to mud. The camera sits low and a little crooked on a desk, looking up and slightly tilted at a tanned, broad-faced man in his early fifties with a deep orange-brown tan that stops abruptly at a pale band along his hairline, creased squint lines, a high shiny forehead, thin sandy-grey hair combed into a neat side parting, a soft rounded jaw with a little loose skin under it, and small bright pleased-with-himself eyes that are looking at something off the edge of the screen, not at the lens. He wears a navy quilted gilet zipped up over a pale blue open-collared shirt, and he is chewing a mouthful of salad from a clear plastic supermarket tub held near his chin, a fork hovering, a leaf of rocket stuck to the fork. Behind him is a dark wooden bookcase crammed with unevenly stacked hardbacks and a framed photo of a sailing boat, its books too blurred and blocky to read. The only light is a flat cool glow from the laptop screen on his face and a bright overexposed window to one side that blows out the edge of the frame. Nothing is written on the picture anywhere: no text, no numbers, no icons, no borders, just the raw picture. Thanks.

label: Bald pale man, rimless glasses, white wall
prompt: A blurry, over-compressed frame from a laptop webcam on a video call, a little pixelated, with a greenish-grey cast and flat dull light from a ceiling lamp out of shot. A narrow, long-faced bald man in his late forties sits very upright and close to the camera, so his head fills the middle of the frame and the top is slightly cut off. His scalp is pale and faintly shiny with a few freckles, his eyebrows are thin and almost invisible, his cheeks are hollow with a pinched, slightly sour mouth, a long nose, and a blotchy shaving rash on his neck. He wears rimless glasses that catch two small glare spots from the screen, and a pewter-grey fleece-lined gilet over a white shirt with the collar buttoned too high. He is forking limp lettuce and a few cherry tomatoes out of a Tupperware box with his eyes drifting to the side, plainly reading something else, jaw working slowly. Behind him is a bare white wall with one tall artificial pot plant with glossy dust-covered leaves in the right corner and nothing else at all. The picture has no writing, numbers, symbols or overlays of any kind, only the plain webcam image. Thanks.

label: Ruddy floppy-haired man, green gilet, kitchen
prompt: A still from a cheap laptop webcam during a video call, smeared and blocky with compression, the highlights glowing and the colours slightly oversaturated and smudged, as if the signal were struggling. The camera is propped on a kitchen island and looks up the man's chin. He is a heavy, big-framed man in his late thirties with a ruddy, windburnt, red-veined face, broken capillaries across his round cheeks and nose, a double chin, a thick neck, small pale blue eyes under sandy eyebrows, and a thick floppy fringe of dirty-blond hair falling across his forehead and sticking up at the back. He wears a bottle-green quilted gilet over a rumpled pink checked shirt with the sleeves pushed up his thick forearms. He is hunched over a large wooden bowl of salad, shovelling a forkful in while his eyes slide off to one side, half asleep with boredom. Behind him is a big new kitchen extension: a pale grey island unit, glass bi-fold doors onto a lawn in flat white daylight that burns out the glass, a row of copper pans hung in a line. The only light is the daylight behind him and the pale screen glow in front. No text, numbers, icons, borders or interface appear anywhere on the picture, which is just the raw image. Thanks.
